root.label: Trump administration announces voluntary insurer access pledge

events.label: Trump administration announces voluntary insurer access pledge

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence: In June 2025, six months after UnitedHealthcare's CEO was shot in New York, the Trump administration announced a highly publicized industry pledge, signed by dozens of major health insurers, to remove some of the barriers that block or delay patients from accessing doctor-recommended care.

slots.name: pledge status
slots.sentence: And yet that pledge was voluntary, and it carries no penalties if companies fail to comply.
